gui.guhs.kledingbron.camping_markt: The Grill Campground and the Barter Market
structure.guhs.grillcamping.tooltip: A tent village of guhs around a big campfire, with the Camp Boss Guh and the Lumberjack Guh (Guhbarbecuether)
structure.guhs.mika_ruilmarkt.tooltip: The market of the Nether Mikas: stalls around the Weigh House, with the Market Master Mika (Guhbarbecuether)
block.guhs.campingmarkt_kampvuur.lore: Light it with a flint and steel, put it out with a shovel. Marshmallows go with it, nyeg!
block.guhs.campingmarkt_weegschaal.lore: Click it: it weighs what you hold in your two hands. The fullest hand is the heaviest.
item.guhs.campingmarkt_tentzak.lore: Click a green VRIJ (vacant) sign at the Grill Campground with it: flomp, a tent!
item.guhs.campingmarkt_brandhout.lore: Chopped it yourself. Belongs on the big campfire of the Grill Campground
item.guhs.campingmarkt_roosterstok.lore: Hold right-click on a burning campfire and let go when the marshmallow is golden brown
item.guhs.campingmarkt_roosterstok.lore2: Too early is cold, too late is black. You need marshmallow nibbles. Nyeg!
item.guhs.campingmarkt_recept_plantageba: From the Camp Boss Guh: this is how you grow your own firewood in a box
Simply stays in your crafting table when you make a Plantation Box. Nyeg!
item.guhs.campingmarkt_keurstempel.lore: Click the stack of chonk you think is fake with it. Weigh first!
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.plek.eerst_praten: This spot is vacant. Ask the Camp Boss Guh at the reception for a tent bag, nyeg
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.plek.geen_zak: You don't have a tent bag on you. The Camp Boss Guh has another one
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.plek.bezet: A tent just went up here. Find another green VRIJ sign (or wait a moment)
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.plek.haringen: Your tent is already up! Hammer in the stakes: click the iron pegs
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.plek.tent: What a cozy little tent, nyeg
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.plek.klaar: Everyone pitches their own tent here. Yours was here already. Nyeg, what a beauty it was!
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.plek.geen_ruimte: Something is in the way on this spot
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.plek.staat: Flomp! Your tent is up. Now hammer in the four stakes (click them)
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.haring.eerst_tent: Pitch your own tent first: click a green VRIJ sign with the tent bag
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.haring.klaar: Four stakes in: your tent stands solid as a rock. Wahoog! Now off to the Lumberjack Guh
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.hak.eerst_praten: First ask the Lumberjack Guh if you may chop, nyeg
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.hak.klaar: Six logs! You get a bundle of firewood: toss it on the big campfire
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.vuur.hout_later: This wood is for the campfire party. Not just yet, nyeg
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.vuur.feest: WHOOSH! The campfire is burning and the party begins. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.vuur.opgepookt: You poke up the fire: it's burning nicely again
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.vuur.hout_in_hand: Hold the Lumberjack Guh's firewood in your hand and click the fire
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.vuur.uit: The campfire is out. No wood, no party, nyeg
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.vuur.warm: Nice and warm by the fire. Nyeg
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stok.geen_vuur: Hold the stick over a burning campfire (hold right-click)
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stok.geen_marshmal: There's no marshmallow on your stick. You need marshmallow nibbles
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stok.vuur_weg: You're too far from the fire
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stok.koud: Still cold. Hold it over the fire a bit longer
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stok.bijna: Almost! Not quite golden brown yet. A little longer
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stok.verkoold: Nyeg, burnt to a crisp! You wipe the stick clean: just try again
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stok.goud: Mmm, golden brown and sticky. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stok.goud_klaar: Three golden brown marshmallows! Go tell the Camp Boss Guh
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.nodig.hout: Logs chopped on the chopping block
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.beloning.pakje: The camping outfit: hat, scout neckerchief and backpack
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.beloning.extraatje: A little extra with every trade with a Nether Mika
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.weegschaal.leeg: Put something in your hands: your main hand is the left pan, your other hand the right one
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.weegschaal.midden: Exactly the same weight: %s against %s. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stapel.eerst_afdin: Paws off! First ask the Market Master Mika what's going on here
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stapel.klaar: Real chonk. All of it. The Market Master is keeping a close eye on them now
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stapel.eerst_wegen: Weigh first, stamp after! Click two stacks (without the seal)
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stapel.echt: Stack %s is real chonk! The trickster quickly shuffles the stacks: weigh again
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stapel.ontmaskerd: FAKE! Stack %s is a cheese nibble in purple paper. Go tell the Market Master!
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stapel.links: Stack %s is on the left pan. Click another stack for the right pan
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stapel.terug: Stack %s comes off the scale again
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stapel.weeg.links: The scale tips to the left: stack %s is heavier than stack %s
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stapel.weeg.rechts: The scale tips to the right: stack %s is lighter than stack %s
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.stapel.weeg.midden: The scale stays level: stack %s and stack %s weigh the same
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.schaal.uitleg: Click two stacks of chonk on the counter to weigh them. Then stamp the fake one
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.ruil.extraatje: The Market Master knows you: you get a little extra!
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.ruil.kraam: Sold! Here comes your surprise. Meow!
gui.guhs.campingmarkt.commando.stand: Camping-market of %s: campground step %s (stakes %s, wood %s, roasted %s), barter market step %s (fake %s, weighings %s)
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.hallo1: Nyeg! Welcome to Grill Campground The Glowing Guh! Nice and warm, huh? Underfloor heating from the whole Barbecuether.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.hallo2: Whoever wants to stay here pitches their own tent. Here's a tent bag: find a green VRIJ sign (that means vacant) on the yellow grass by the gate and click it!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.tentzak: Lost your tent bag? Nyeg nyeg. I had one more under the desk. Here!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.tent: Find a green VRIJ sign (the yellow grass by the gate) and click it with the tent bag. All taken? Wait a moment: tents pack themselves back into the bag.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.haringe: Your tent is up! Now hammer in %s more stakes: click the iron pegs at the corners of your tent.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.hout: Lovely tent! Now for a campfire party. But no wood, no fire: ask the Lumberjack Guh at the woodshed for firewood.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.vuur: Got the firewood? Toss it on the big campfire in the middle. Then the party begins, wahoog!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.stok: What a party! Now for the yummiest part: marshmallows. Here's my Roasting Stick and a little bag of marshmallows. Roast %s of them golden brown!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.stok_ui: Hold right-click on the burning campfire and let go when it's GOLDEN BROWN. Too early is cold, too late is black. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.marshma: Out of marshmallows? Here are four more. %s more golden brown ones to go!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.rooster: %s more golden brown marshmallows! Has the fire gone out? Click it and you'll poke it right back up.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.klaar1: Three golden brown ones! You're a real camper guh. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.klaar2: This is for you: the camping outfit for your guh, and my recipe card for the Plantation Box. That's where I grow my own firewood!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.recept_: Lost your recipe card? Good thing I traced a copy. Here, nyeg!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.tip0: With the Roasting Stick you can roast marshmallows anywhere: over any burning campfire, even during the day.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.tip1: With tent canvas you can build your own tent at home. The sloped pieces are the roof, nyeg.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.tip2: A Plantation Box needs chonk power. Just ask the Inventor Guh in the Old Guh Wheel Power Plant how that works.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampbaas.tip3: Rule one of the campground: last one awake makes the coffee. Rule two: I'm never the last one awake.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.houthakker.te_vr: Chop! Chop! ...Oh, hello. I'm busy chopping. Go see the Camp Boss Guh first, nyeg.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.houthakker.hallo: Firewood for the campfire? I've got that! ...in whole logs. And my pawsies are tired from chopping.
Will you chop six logs on my chopping block? Just click it: chop! Then I'll tie them into a nice bundle.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.houthakker.nog: %s more logs! Chop chop. Mind your own tail.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.houthakker.hout_: Lost your bundle of wood? How do you even lose a bundle of wood... Here, a new one.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.houthakker.naar_: There's your bundle of firewood! Go go, off to the big campfire with it.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.houthakker.tip0: Satay wood burns the best. Sausage wood smells the best. Spruce wood is just wood.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.houthakker.tip1: I've been chopping my whole life. Bonked my thumb exactly once. Been wearing a cap ever since. Doesn't help a bit, but it looks good.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.houthakker.tip2: Want a chopping block at home too? An axe on a log, done. Chop!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.houthakker.tip3: The Camp Boss Guh grows his wood in a box. A BOX! That's no forest in my book, nyeg.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.hint.tent: Click a green VRIJ (vacant) sign by the campground gate with the tent bag
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.hint.hak: Click a chopping block at the woodshed six times
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.hint.marshmallow: Get the Roasting Stick from the Camp Boss Guh
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.hint.rooster: Roast three marshmallows golden brown over the big campfire
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.hint.kampbaas: Tell the Camp Boss Guh at the reception
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.hint.afdingen: Talk to the Market Master Mika and haggle: a compliment when he brags, a low offer when he sighs, walk away when he growls
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.hint.wegen: Weigh the five stacks of chonk in the Weigh House (click two stacks) and stamp the lightest one
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampeerder.0: Nyeg! Camping is the best thing there is. Especially the food.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampeerder.1: My air mattress has a leak. Luckily I'm pretty soft myself.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampeerder.2: Are you in the mood for marshmallows too? I'm ALWAYS in the mood for marshmallows.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampeerder.3: The Camp Boss Guh whistles every morning at six o'clock. Nobody knows why.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampeerder.4: Last night I heard rustling by my tent. It was my own tummy.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kampeerder.5: When the campfire is burning, we all start dancing. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.marktmeester.hal: Meow! Welcome to the Nether Mika Barter Market. I am the Market Master. No touching the chonk ingots!
Somebody here is paying with FAKE CHONK. Will you help me look? Then first you need to know how to haggle, or the whole market will laugh at you. Talk to me again!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.marktmeester.gel: That's how it's done! When a Mika brags: give a compliment. When he sighs: offer low. When he growls: walk away. Remember that, meow.
Here is my Seal of Approval. In the Weigh House there are five stacks of chonk: one is fake, and fake chonk is LIGHTER. Weigh them and stamp the fake one!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.marktmeester.wee: In the Weigh House, click two stacks: the scale shows which one is lighter. Are you sure? Then click the fake stack with the Seal of Approval.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.marktmeester.ste: Lost your seal? Meow meow. Here's a new one. Don't stamp your forehead!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.marktmeester.kla: FAKE! A cheese nibble in purple paper! That's the work of my little nephew Smikkel... he ate the real ingot. I'll deal with it.
You get this scale. And I'll spread the word: from now on every Nether Mika gives you a little extra when you trade. Meow!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.marktmeester.koo: Meow, there's my best haggler! I've got a deal of the day. Win the haggling and it's yours. Or are you here for my little shop?
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.marktmeester.opt: Haggle for the deal of the day!
Go on, show me your little shop
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.marktmeester.koo: Sold! The deal of the day is yours. Tomorrow I'll have a new one, meow.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.marktmeester.tip: On my market the stall Mikas trade right away: a wahoog chonk ingot in, a surprise out. No sniffing it over first.
Real chonk is heavy. As heavy as a chonky guh after breakfast. Fake chonk weighs nothing, meow.
Every day I have one deal for whoever haggles well. You've already had today's. Come back tomorrow!
My little nephew Smikkel now has to sweep the market for a whole week. With his tail.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.begin.0: Just look at it, what a market! Built it with my own paws, the prettiest in the whole Barbecuether. A market permit costs %s nibbles. (Patience: %s)
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.begin.1: Sigh... so quiet today. Nobody's buying anything. A market permit costs %s nibbles. Or... oh well. (Patience: %s)
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.begin.2: Grrr! %s nibbles for a market permit. That's my final offer! Really! My very, very last! (Patience: %s)
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.goed.0: Hmph, well played. %s nibbles then. And do you see my hat? The tallest hat on the market, picked it out myself! (Patience: %s)
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.goed.1: Meow, clever. %s nibbles then. Sigh... and I still have seven little Mikas to feed. Seven! (Patience: %s)
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.goed.2: Fine, %s nibbles. But I am NOT going any lower! Never! This really is my final offer! Grrr! (Patience: %s)
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.fout.0: No no, that's not how it works! It stays %s. I'm the boss of the prettiest market there is, you know! (Patience: %s)
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.fout.1: Wrong guess. It stays %s. Sigh... what a day. And my pawsies are so sore too. (Patience: %s)
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.fout.2: Miss! It stays %s nibbles. Grrr, my final offer, and I'm sticking to it! (Patience: %s)
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.gewonne: %s nibbles?! Meow... sold. You know what: for such a good haggler it's free. You've got the knack!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.afdingen.weggest: SHOO! I'm out of patience! ...Come back in a bit and we'll just start over. Meow.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kraam.0.0: Meow! Fresh satay, picked just this morning! For one wahoog chonk ingot you get a surprise.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kraam.0.1: No tasting. Sniffing is fine. Sniffing is free. For now.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kraam.0.2: Got wahoog chonk on you? Just hold it up and we'll do business!
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kraam.1.0: Chonk! Real chonk! Heavy chonk! No fakes at my stall, just ask the Market Master.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kraam.1.1: A chonk ingot in, a surprise out. That's how trading works, meow.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kraam.1.2: Don't blow out the candles. They're for the mood.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kraam.2.0: Glowing embers! Grill coal! Everything nice and warm. Don't put it in your pocket.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kraam.2.1: For one wahoog chonk ingot you may dig around in my surprise bag.
quest.guhs.campingmarkt.kraam.2.2: My stall is the warmest on the whole market. That's not an ad, that's a warning.
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.uitleg: At the Grill Campground, guhs live in little tents around a big campfire. Whoever wants to stay pitches their own tent.
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.stap.0: Talk to the Camp Boss Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.nu.0: Find the Grill Campground and talk to the Camp Boss Guh at the reception.
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.waar.0: The Grill Campground in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.nu.1: Click a green VRIJ (vacant) sign with the tent bag and hammer in the four stakes of your tent (click the iron pegs).
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.waar.1: The campsites by the gate of the Grill Campground
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.nu.2: Ask the Lumberjack Guh for firewood and chop six logs on his chopping block.
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.waar.2: The woodshed of the Grill Campground
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.nu.3: Toss the bundle of firewood on the big campfire.
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.waar.3: The big campfire, in the middle of the Grill Campground
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.nu.4: Get the Roasting Stick from the Camp Boss Guh, roast three marshmallows golden brown over the campfire and tell him.
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.waar.4: The big campfire of the Grill Campground
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.nu.klaar: You're a real camper guh! With the Roasting Stick you can roast marshmallows anywhere, and with the recipe card you can make a Plantation Box.
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.waar.klaar: The Grill Campground in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.kort.0: Talk to the Camp Boss Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.kort.1: Pitch your tent and hammer in the four stakes
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.kort.2: Chop six logs at the Lumberjack Guh's
gui.guhs.verhalen.camping.kort.3: Toss the firewood on the big campfire
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.naam: The Fake Chonk of the Barter Market
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.uitleg: At the Nether Mika Barter Market somebody is paying with fake chonk. The Market Master Mika is looking for a clever haggler to help him.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.stap.0: Talk to the Market Master Mika
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.nu.0: Find the Nether Mika Barter Market and talk to the Market Master Mika in front of the Weigh House.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.waar.0: The Nether Mika Barter Market in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.nu.1: Talk to the Market Master and haggle his price down from 30 to 10 nibbles: a compliment when he brags, a low offer when he sighs, walk away when he growls.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.waar.1: The Market Master Mika, in front of the Weigh House
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.nu.2: Weigh the five stacks of chonk in the Weigh House (click two stacks) and click the stack that is lighter with the Seal of Approval.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.waar.2: The Weigh House, in the middle of the barter market
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.nu.3: Tell the Market Master Mika which stack was fake.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.waar.3: The Market Master Mika, in front of the Weigh House
gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.nu.klaar: The fake chonk is unmasked! From now on every Nether Mika gives you a little extra when you trade, and every day you can haggle for the deal of the day.

gui.guhs.verhalen.ruilmarkt.kort.2: Weigh the stacks of chonk and stamp the fake one
